## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipākattika* ("The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon [Nyanatiloka 1983]. Structurally cataloged as Patthana 7.3, it forms the third triad in the sequence of 22 triads (*ttika*), situated between the *Vedanāttika* (the triad of feelings) and triads such as the *Upādinnattika* (or *Upādānattika*) and *Saṅkiliṭṭhattika* [Nyanatiloka 1983].

Within the broader framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text participates in the systematic structural analysis characteristic of the work's major chapters [Nyanatiloka 1983].
